fact_text: The budget added a carbon levy on fossil-fuel petrol and diesel cars: 1% for engines up to 1300cc, 2% for 1300cc to 1800cc, and 3% above 1800cc.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The carbon levy on trucks and buses is 1%, and the government says the levy is meant to promote a cleaner environment and hybrid and electric vehicles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The analyst noted that Pakistan has not yet announced an electric vehicle policy, including a special tariff for EV charging, even though a carbon levy was introduced.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The budget did not allow imports of used cars up to five years old, which the market had feared would be opened.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The analyst judged the FY26 budget neutral overall for the PSX-listed sectors, with autos the main exception because of some negative proposals.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The analyst said the market reacted positively to the budget because no major negative measure hit listed companies, and higher taxes on some debt income heads may support equities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The analyst said the FY26 budget balances fiscal discipline against growth ambitions, and the government is avoiding populist moves that could overheat the economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The federal government's target for the combined provincial surplus in FY26 is about PKR 1.4 trillion, compared with an expected provincial surplus of about PKR 1 trillion in FY25.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The analyst said the provinces could fall short of the PKR 1.4 trillion surplus target, but the FY26 targets would still be in line with IMF expectations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The FY26 federal development budget (PSDP) is PKR 1 trillion, and the analyst said it is more a provincial subject than a federal one, so cuts there are possible.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The analyst called the FY26 revenue target somewhat optimistic and expected mid-year adjustments to cover any shortfall from other budget heads.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The FY26 fiscal deficit target is described as the most aggressive since 2008, and Pakistan's targets are more aggressive than those of the IMF and Fitch.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: Dividends from mutual funds earning income from debt profits are taxed at 25%, the same rate as the prior year, and the budget clarified how mixed funds are taxed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: Under the budget wording, a fund's dividend is taxed in proportion to its average holdings: a balanced fund 51% in debt has 51% of its dividend taxed at 25% and 49% taxed at 15%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: Money market and debt funds are expected to be taxed at 25% as before, because most of their assets are invested in debt and money market instruments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The budget removed the tax exemption on voluntary pension scheme (VPS) withdrawals, a move the analyst called surprising and expects will be revisited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: Pakistan's unfunded pension liabilities were called a ticking time bomb by multilateral agencies, and the VPS scheme was the plan to build a funded pool for new and then existing employees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: The VPS fund is only about PKR 100 billion in size, so the government's direct contribution from its tax treatment is small.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: Under the removed exemption, a company provident fund transferred into a VPS is taxed on the full amount rather than only on capital gains, so the transfer window matters before the finance bill is final.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Geopolitical Uncertainty Halts PSX Rally | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-06-14)

fact_text: Foreign investors have been net sellers on the PSX in FY25 despite improved macro stability and rating upgrades.
